audience: Customer care advocates leaving and returning to their desks
one_message: Lock your screen and clear your desk every time you step away.
action: Lock, shred, clear, before standing up
seen_from: A corridor wall, about 3 metres, for 3 seconds
tone: Warm, plain, respectful. A reminder between colleagues, not a warning.
direction: A solid orange disc cropped by the corner with a charcoal padlock on it; plain flush-left headline; serif italic on the one word that is the risk
must_not: the company logo redrawn by hand

copy.headline: Lock it before you leave it.
copy.why: Ten seconds at your desk protects the people who trust us with their information.
